'''Raklings''' were a small bipedal species similar to [[rakghoul]]s.

Raklings could be created when mutated by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. They could also be kept as pets.

==Behind the scenes==
Raklings are available as a mini pet in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
